title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

exact_text.read_as: Fern House in all three variants
Weekend Plant Sale in all three variants
20% off all indoor plants in all three variants
Saturday & Sunday in all three variants
Visit 24 Willow Lane in all three variants, although the middle letters of Willow are visibly malformed in the vertical image

faults.what: The vertical variant has overlapping, malformed strokes in the middle of “Willow.” The address remains decipherable, but this conspicuous lettering defect needs correction before posting, especially given the explicit requirement for address readability.

judge.summary: The three coordinated ads contain all required copy and adapt well to their formats, but distorted lettering in the vertical address needs repair.

must_haves.item: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: The delivered images have the requested square, tall portrait, and wide landscape proportions.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
must_haves.why: All five strings are present and identifiable in each image; the portrait uses line breaks within the brand, headline, and address.

must_haves.item: Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
must_haves.why: Text sizes are adequate throughout, but the malformed middle letters of “Willow” compromise comfortable reading of the portrait address.

must_haves.item: Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
must_haves.why: Dark green lettering contrasts clearly with the cream backgrounds, and foliage stays outside the text areas.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
must_haves.why: Margins are sufficient and no text is clipped, but the vertical image contains visibly distorted lettering in “Willow.”

must_haves.item: The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.
must_haves.why: The palette, leafy imagery, and typographic hierarchy are coordinated; portrait copy is stacked, while landscape imagery and copy are arranged side by side.
